_: Channel summaries, generated. Keyed by repo ("concordego" for ConcordeGo's notes), then a hash of the channel's source notes + tools/release-notes-prompt.md + the model (see channel_key in sync-releases.py). Written by tools/summarize-notes.py in the GitHub Action (model = the Claude model that wrote it) or by hand (model "hand"). Edit "bullets" freely: an entry is kept until its channel's notes change. "fold": true adds the closing "Plus smaller fixes and polish" line. An entry with "failed" is ignored by the page and asked again after 7 days; delete it to try sooner. Keep this file valid JSON: while it does not parse, nothing is summarized.

bullets: **Image generation** — ask for a picture and you get one; it runs on your Mac, or a cloud model fills in
**Model downloads** — progress reflects what is actually downloading and names each item; the preset that fits your disk is marked
**Enable visual effects** — replaces performance mode and now switches only the moving backdrop, not spinners and animations
**Check for updates automatically** — your choice: at launch and once a day, or only when you press the button
**Windows** — chats, web search, read-aloud and voice input on Intel, AMD and ARM PCs; Ollama is installed for you
**Video and exports** — short clips rendered on your Mac, and answers saved in twenty formats, from PDF to slides
**Chats saved as you go** — questions and answers are kept even after Stop or quit; the 60-chat limit is gone
**Removed** — Contribute and the free community image cloud
**Sidebar meters** — the hardware meters card in the sidebar gets even spacing around the chip name and bars
**Bonding** — spread the tunnel across the connections you tick
**Speed line** — now warns when a test measured only a share of the line
**Removed** — the "Auto" option in Route
**Kill switch** — while the tunnel is up, nothing gets around it
**Speed modes** — Auto optimize speed-tests each network to pick its mode; Performance and Ultra use the fastest protocol
**Servers** — OS updates from the app, and a warning on a server that isn't answering
Apps that require encrypted DNS, such as IPTV One, no longer stall; switching off no longer strands connections
**Round-trip fares** — each fare shows who sells it, with other countries' booking sites as links
**Sorting** — a sort menu beside the results, including fastest door to door and soonest at your door
**Points and miles** — priced on airlines' published award charts, with a transfer planner; phone-only awards flagged
**Flight details** — per-cabin airline ratings, a comfort grade, a price history chart, and the journey laid out
